behavior:audio-vivid-metadata-runtime-pl.candidate: Kept genuine unsupported/error behavior; no dummy builder, fabricated metadata or empty success.
behavior:audio-vivid-metadata-runtime-pl.remaining: Real Audio Vivid metadata format/algorithm plugin with provenance/license and installed ABI, objects/positions/gain metadata serialization roundtrip and lifecycle/error validation on the new package.

behavior:video-encoder-dependent-media-p.source_finding: Recording/screen-capture/transcoding share the actual encoder input; existing software AVC and truthful hardware capability preparation do not validate complete pipelines.
behavior:video-encoder-dependent-media-p.candidate: Fixes actual shared AVC byte routing, supported layouts, bounds and rejected-surface release without replacing backend data.
